Madame de Geoffrin

[A French lady, distinguished for her patronage of learning and the fine arts; born in Paris, 1699; was intimate with many celebrated characters; died 1777.]
That gentleman, sir, was my husband: he is dead.
When asked who a quiet old gentleman was, who had not been present in her 
salon
 for a month.
